title: Obtain the company tax identifiers
summary: Obtain or confirm the tax identifiers needed by the company. Some jurisdictions issue them during incorporation; others require a separate application or tax registration.

parts.title: Prepare the company tax-registration information
parts.guidance: Collect the legal entity details and existing registration records. Determine which tax identifiers were issued at formation and what additional registration is required by the company’s jurisdiction. Keep identifiers and responsible-person details in the private workspace.

references.title: IRS get an EIN

execution.rationale: Build the EIN application worksheet from accepted entity records and responsible-party facts.

geoResolutions.label: Pre-fill EIN application data
geoResolutions.guidance: Apply for an Employer Identification Number (EIN) from the IRS for the newly incorporated company. Collect the legal name, formation details and address from the accepted entity documents. Identify the responsible party, business activity, tax classification and reason for applying. Check whether an EIN already exists and which IRS application channel the entity can use. Resolve uncertain answers with the responsible person before filing, and keep tax identifiers in the private application workspace.

parts.title: Obtain or confirm the company tax identifiers
parts.guidance: Check the accepted formation documents for identifiers already issued. Where a separate application is required, use the local tax authority’s procedure after authorized review. Save the confirmation and identify any additional tax programme accounts.

execution.rationale: The eligible applicant personally completes the IRS online application. Existing restrictions on automated access remain; an ineligible applicant must use the permitted alternative route.

geoResolutions.label: Complete IRS SS-4 form online
geoResolutions.guidance: Use the IRS application method for which the entity and responsible party qualify. Review the answers against the prepared facts and current instructions. The authorized representative approves submission; a third-party designee needs signed authorization. Complete the required identity or signature steps and save the IRS confirmation. If the applicant is ineligible for the online assistant, use the appropriate IRS alternative with accurate identity details.

verify.how: The EIN is issued in the XX-XXXXXXX format at the end of the online session — retain the CP 575 confirmation notice; banks and payroll providers ask for it.

cost.note: The IRS issues EINs for free; third-party services charge to file on your behalf.

geoResolutions.label: PAN and TAN — the company's tax identifiers — are allotted automatically as part of the SPICe+ incorporation filing; the Income Tax e-filing portal is where the company then uses them.
There is no EIN application: HMRC posts the company a Unique Taxpayer Reference (UTR) automatically after incorporation, and you register for Corporation Tax within 3 months of starting business.
The tax office issues a Steuernummer after you file the Fragebogen zur steuerlichen Erfassung (tax registration questionnaire) on ELSTER — plus a separate VAT ID from the BZSt if needed.
No application: INSEE allots the SIREN (company) and SIRET (per-establishment) identifiers automatically when the guichet unique registration lands — they arrive with the company's registration.

No separate tax-ID application: the NIPC issued at incorporation is the company's tax number (NIF), and filing the declaração de início de atividade with the tax authority activates it for corporate tax and VAT.

A CRA business number is issued automatically with federal (and most provincial) incorporation — you add program accounts to it (payroll RP, GST/HST RT, corporate tax RC) through Business Registration Online rather than applying for a separate tax ID.
No separate tax-ID application: the Companies Office incorporation application lets you choose to register for an Inland Revenue (IRD) number, a GST number, and as an employer in the same filing.
There is no EIN application: ACRA assigns the company's UEN at incorporation and it is the identification number across Singapore government agencies, IRAS included — tax filings simply run on it.

The tax identifiers are a real application: the company applies to the Australian Business Register for an ABN (the company TFN rides the same flow), and most founders file it inside the Business Registration Service alongside the ASIC company registration (law rule au.abn-registration).

The tax identity is the business registration number (사업자등록번호), applied for with the district tax office within 20 days of starting business and available before the start date (Value-Added Tax Act Article 8); corporations file it through Hometax after the registry incorporation.

There is no separate application: the one-stop incorporation files the Notice to Business Registration Office (IRBR1) with the NNC1, so the business registration certificate — whose number doubles as the company's tax reference — issues together with the certificate of incorporation (law rule hk.business-registration-certificate).

The tax identity arrives with formation: the registry code (registrikood) is assigned on entry in the commercial register and identifies the company to the Tax and Customs Board; a separate VAT number comes only with VAT registration (law rule ee.vat-registration-threshold).
Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Reconcile the KVK registration and tax-administration records, including any identifiers issued through formation. Confirm which registrations still need action for the entity and its activities; the company register and tax obligations are distinct. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: KVK Business Register and Tax Administration

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Review Revenue registration for the actual company and tax heads. Confirm the CRO number, tax representation and appropriate ROS or form route before submitting; incorporation alone does not settle all tax registration. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Use Agencia Tributaria census guidance to confirm NIF assignment and the applicable business census declarations. Review the entity facts and representation before filing; retain confirmation of actual registration rather than relying on an application draft. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: Agencia Tributaria tax census and NIF

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Use Skatteverket startup registration guidance to assess F-tax, VAT and employer registration for the selected business. Verify the register extract and outstanding applications; do not assume one approval covers every tax role. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: Skatteverket starting and registering a business

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Confirm the commercial-register and UID record, then separately assess registration with the Federal Tax Administration for VAT. The VAT service describes required company and representative evidence; it does not determine every federal and cantonal tax obligation. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: Swiss Federal Tax Administration VAT registration

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Use National Tax Agency corporation-establishment guidance to identify the relevant tax notices and salary-office registration work. Confirm the entity and local-tax requirements with an adviser; English reference forms do not establish completed filing or every applicable obligation. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: Japan National Tax Agency notification guidelines

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Confirm CNPJ registration and reconcile it with the entity record. Have the responsible accountant identify additional state, municipal and tax-regime registrations for the actual activities; a CNPJ alone is not a completed tax-compliance setup. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: Brazil register an entity in CNPJ

geoResolutions.label: Confirm the country-specific tax-registration route
geoResolutions.guidance: Review Federal Tax Authority corporate-tax registration for the specific person and entity structure. Confirm applicable registration and deadlines with an adviser, and assess VAT separately; free-zone status does not establish a blanket tax exemption. Launch entry point only; qualified local review is required.
geoResolutions.actionLabel: UAE Federal Tax Authority corporate tax registration

verify.how: Retain the official confirmation or accepted documents required for this step in the selected jurisdiction; reconcile them with the approved company records.

parts.title: Store the tax identifiers in company records
parts.guidance: Store the verified identifiers, issuing authority and confirmation privately. Make them available only to authorized users and downstream filings that require them.

execution.rationale: File and cross-check the supplied EIN confirmation in the authorized records workspace using file tools.
